newsitem.title: USA: FNB Financial subsidiary changes name.
newsitem.headline: FNB Financial subsidiary changes name.

text.p: FNB Financial Services Corp's President and Chief Executive Officer, Ernest Sewell, said the name of the company's wholly owned subsidiary, First National Bank of Reidsville, would change to First National Bank Southeast.

"Our expansion program, which has recently taken us into new markets in Wilmington and Greensboro, N.C., necessitated that we adopt a name which more clearly identified our current franchise, while not limiting our future growth with geographical boundaries," said Sewell.
First National Bank has seven offices located in North Carolina.
